about: Best known result for each tracked question on 2026-11-14. Edited only through labyrinth/seed.py.

entries.result: Every cubic bipartite 3-connected planar graph has a Hamiltonian cycle avoiding any prescribed edge.
entries.status: LIT: three 2026 preprints, unrefereed; Lean proof builds locally with standard axioms; reverse-Lamport audits: OpenAI and trees paper FOLLOW, Li follows with four routine steps supplied (AI, unreviewed)

previous.was: verified by computer up to 90 vertices (Brinkmann-Goedgebeur-McKay)
proved for faces of size at most 8 (Schnieders)

entries.cls: Shortest rigorous proof of Proposition 5.1 (a pair implies a forest pair)
entries.result: Two candidates of about one page: heights as test functions with no weights (comb, rewritten by its referee), and one integer polynomial F with linear weights 1 + xa, real signs and parity only (dim, refd). The Lean proof uses the second form.
entries.status: proved here (1 independent AI referee each; human check pending)

previous.was: Taylor coefficient of an exponential sum with circulation weights (OpenAI)
integer polynomial per exchange component; marked walk (trees paper)
two sign-reversing involutions on marked objects (Li)

entries.cls: Exact hypothesis for the first pair
entries.result: A pair exists iff no separating triangle has black inner boundary, iff t0 is on the black side of every separating triangle. One exact Euler identity proves both directions.
entries.status: LIT (trees paper Thm 1.2); short proof checked in structure referee INTEGRATION.md; final REPORT still provisional; computed on all 7868 roots up to 16 vertices

previous.status: LIT (trees paper Thm 1.2); short proof proved here (gt, under review); computed on all 7868 roots up to 16 vertices

entries.result: Four uses in OpenAI, three in Li. In the real-sign form three uses need only that state cycles are odd; the value 3 is used once.

entries.cls: Lower bound on the number of tree matchings of a rooted triangulation with a pair
entries.result: At least 2 cmin, and always even. Conjecture: at least 2^cmin (5088 cases, equality in 4609).
entries.status: 2 cmin proved here (1 AI referee; human check pending); 2^cmin conjecture

previous.was: at least 2: both signs occur in every exchange component (trees paper Thm 5.2)

entries.cls: Fraction of states that are tree matchings
entries.result: Can be (2/3)^q on 5q + 3 vertices: 3^q states, 2^q tree matchings.
entries.status: proved here, checked in structure referee INTEGRATION.md Section 6; computed for q <= 6

previous.status: proved here (lim, under review); computed for q <= 6

entries.cls: Which Hamiltonian cycles arise from tree matchings
entries.result: Exactly the cycles avoiding e0* whose state has a partner. Recovery is injective, not onto (prism: 2 of 4). 3 #TM <= #HC(G).
entries.status: proved here (comb: 1 AI referee; lim, gt: under review)

entries.result: Z = i^(-n) [prod y_t] det(sum_t y_t M_t) with rank-two real blocks; 2^n determinant evaluations. Found independently by four agents; the versions coincide by a gauge through the 3-colouring. No formula without coefficient extraction.
entries.status: proved here (1 independent AI referee; human check pending)

previous.was: the number of states is |det K_B| (trees paper Lemma 6.1)

entries.result: None. Deterministic polynomial space and O(poly(N) 3^(N/4)) time; marked walk 2^O(n log n). Uniform sampling of states is polynomial. The abstract problem without the spoke-graph structure is NP-hard.
entries.status: LIT bounds (trees paper); NP-hardness proved here modulo a cited theorem (gt, under review)

entries.result: All rooted Eulerian triangulations with at most 16 vertices: states, pairs and tree matchings agree between two independent implementations (7868 roots); a third recount by a referee agrees.
entries.status: exhaustive (T3; no referee of the comparison itself)

entries.result: The upstream Lean proof builds locally (Lean 4.34.1); axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. It proves the conjecture as usually stated, by a route that differs from the paper in four places. Not formalised: Corollary 7.2, Theorem 2.2.

entries.cls: Review state of the proofs written in this project
entries.result: AI-refereed: route-combinatorics (FOLLOWS with corrections), determinant claims of route-constructive and route-dimers (CORRECT). Under review: route-graph-theory, limits. Unreviewed: dependency-graph, machinery-literature, route-algebra, route-topology, route-categorical, lean-formalisation, the referees' own additions. Human-checked: none.
Each one, with a witness: K4 (bipartite), theta of cubes on 26 vertices (3-connected), triangular bipyramid radial graph (cubic), 3 x 3 torus (sphere).
